name: school-erp
description: SchoolERP monorepo root — npm workspaces tying backend, frontend, and the shared contracts package together. Each workspace still has its own scripts and can be run from inside its own directory; see CLAUDE.md.

scripts.build: npm run build -w contracts && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build -w contracts && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm run build -w contracts && npm run build -w backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w contracts && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
